preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 150000, inclusive.
The integer ai on each vertex is between 0 and n, inclusive.
Each edge and query vertex is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The graph is guaranteed to be a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.
For each query, vertex u is an ancestor of vertex v.

postconditions.description: The output consists of q lines, each containing the answer to a query.

postconditions.expression: Answer is maximal value <image> among all vertices i on path from u to v
postconditions.description: For each query (u, v), the answer is the maximal value of the bitwise XOR of ai for all vertices i on the path from u to v, including u and v.

invariants.expression: The tree is rooted at vertex 1
invariants.description: The tree is rooted at vertex 1, and the path from u to v is the unique path in the tree from the root to v passing through u.
